text: DSH Web Search Brave 为 DSH 接入 Brave 网页搜索，通过 ctx.web 注册提供方，并由 bundle 设为当前搜索后端。每次搜索向 Brave Search API 发起一次请求，将网页结果整理为来源列表，可设置结果数、国家、语言和时间范围。适合需要在 DSH 对话中检索网页资料的用户。需要 Brave Search API 凭证 BRAVE_API_KEY；查询词会发送至 api.search.brave.com。

DSH Web Search Brave adds Brave search to DSH through ctx.web. Each search makes one API request and returns normalized sources, with options for count, country, language, and freshness. It supports web research in DSH. BRAVE_API_KEY is required; queries go to api.search.brave.com.
想让 DSH 在对话里直接搜索网页并返回来源。
I want DSH to fetch web search results for my questions.
DSH Web Search Brave 的功能「网页搜索」：将 DSH 搜索词发送给 Brave Search API，并把网页标题、链接和摘要整理成来源列表。由 web_search 调用触发，可传入搜索词和结果数。
DSH Web Search Brave 使用前须知：搜索词发送至 api.search.brave.com，且需 BRAVE_API_KEY。（见 lib/index.js:198-230、lib/index.js:262-275）

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · @huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [Brave Search API](https://brave.com/search/api/) web search provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), mounted on the official web capability seam (`ctx.web`). One search is one HTTP request — lighter and faster than the bundled DeepSeek provider, which spends a full model turn per search.

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · @huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave：It calls Brave's official endpoint `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search` and maps the structured `web.results[]` into the seam's normalized `WebSearchResult`; the model keeps seeing the same stable `web_search` tool.

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Install：From GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave
```

From a local checkout (development):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/dsh-web-search-brave
```

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Install：The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the plugin and switches `web.searchProvider` from the base bundle's `deepseek-official` to `brave` automatically. To switch back, remove the plugin, or override in your profile patch (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official
```

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Configuration：All fields optional; edit under the `web-search-brave` entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web-search-brave
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: BRAVE_API_KEY
    count: 10

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | — | Literal subscription token (secret); wins over the credentials store when set |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `BRAVE_API_KEY` | Credential reference name, resolved via the credentials service or the launch environment |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search` | API endpoint; custom values need `allowCustomBaseURL: true` and https |
| `allowCustomBaseURL` | `false` | Explicit opt-in for a non-official endpoint |
| `count` | `10` | Results requested per search (1–20; also bounded by the caller's `maxResults`) |
| `country` | — | Two-letter country code (e.g. `cn`, `us`) |
| `searchLang` | — | Search language (e.g. `zh-hans`, `en`) |
| `freshness` | — | Recency filter: `pd` / `pw` / `pm` / `py` or an ISO date range |
| `safesearch` | `moderate` | `strict` / `moderate` / `off` |
| `textDecorations` | `false` | Brave `<b>` highlight markers in snippets; off keeps snippets clean for the model |
| `proxy` | `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` from the launch environment | HTTP proxy URL for the search request |
| `searchTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Hard per-request ti

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Verify：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # the web-search-brave entry is mounted
```

Then ask the model to use `web_search` in a conversation. **Note: installing a new plugin requires a dsh restart to take effect** — the running host does not hot-mount newly installed plugins (edits to an already-mounted plugin's config are hot-reloaded).

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test    # vitest, 43 cases covering mapping / whitelist / timeout / abort / proxy / apply
```

The package ships hand-written ESM sources — what you read is what runs; there is no build step.

@huohua-dev/dsh-web-search-brave README · Security notes：- The only outbound destination is the Brave Search API endpoint (or your explicitly approved https mirror).
- `available()` never throws and never makes network calls, per the seam contract.
- No telemetry, no install hooks, no `!!js` expressions in the shipped patch.
- Structure and error semantics follow the official [@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek) provider.
